mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth (QoQ) is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals weak labor market conditions, which depress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising (MoM), or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) during periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals a supply shock that disrupts corporate supply chains and erodes profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation rate above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals expectations of monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which supports corporate output and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth (MoM) is positive, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and fall in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling (MoM), or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) during a low interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.
